scope: All 50 course quizzes whose IDs do not start with volume-question-bank. Review covers the displayed stem, answer key, and rationale.

statusLegend.supported: The keyed answer fits the stated problem and cited material.
statusLegend.needs-qualification: The keyed choice is plausible, but its rationale needs a stated condition or narrower claim.
statusLegend.uncertain: The source does not establish the claim well enough to assess it.
statusLegend.incorrect: The key or rationale conflicts with the available source.

questions.reason: The labels provide known target classes, and the model predicts one class for each new transaction. This is supervised classification, not clustering, regression, or reward-based learning.

Batch inference fits scheduled bulk scoring with no interactive response requirement. The choice is not guaranteed to have the lowest cost for every workload because service, data volume, and configuration affect cost.
The mapping distinguishes learning from prediction and identifies overfitting as poor generalization after memorization. The keyed sequence matches those definitions.
Amazon Comprehend provides text analysis, including sentiment analysis. The task concerns written reviews, so the image, translation, and speech services do not fit.
Per-token input and output billing is the correct model among these choices. The relative price of output tokens depends on the selected model and current pricing.
A query vector must share the vector space used for indexed documents. Switching embedding models can make similarity comparisons unreliable, even when storage remains available.
Text-to-image generation is a generative image task. Embedding, classification, and clustering models do not produce the requested product images.
MCP defines a reusable protocol for tool and data connections. Implementations differ in supported capabilities, and MCP does not grant AWS permissions or prevent prompt injection.
RAG over a frequently updated manual can retrieve current passages and provide citations. Retrieval does not guarantee that every answer is correct or that the model never invents policies.
Fine-tuning examples can teach response style, so this is the best listed approach for a consistent voice. Prompt design may also meet the need and should be assessed before model customization.
Data selection precedes pre-training. Fine-tuning follows pre-training, evaluation precedes deployment, so the keyed sequence follows the lifecycle described.
A low temperature can reduce output variation. It does not guarantee identical outputs across requests, since model behavior and service execution can vary.
Examples inside the prompt provide demonstrations for the current request. That is few-shot prompting, rather than zero-shot prompting or model compression.
ROUGE measures overlap with reference summaries and fits this comparison. It is one automatic metric, not the universal standard for summary quality.
Knowledge Bases can retrieve changing manual content and return source citations. RAG cannot guarantee that the assistant never invents policies, so review or verification controls remain necessary.
The phase requires an external order-system action. An agent with an action group can invoke an API, while a Knowledge Base retrieves content and Guardrails filter content.
SageMaker Clarify can assess bias in data and models. The other listed services serve security discovery, content controls, or compliance-document access.
Fairness and veracity are responsible-AI properties named in the cited exam material. Model size and nondeterminism do not describe those properties.
The customer configures S3 access controls and selects any required encryption options. S3 applies SSE-S3 by default, while customer-managed KMS keys offer additional key and audit controls.
CloudTrail records Bedrock API activity with caller and time details when the applicable runtime API calls are captured. Config tracks resource state rather than API history.

An EU Region addresses the stated residency and proximity needs. The stem does not specify an availability target, so two AZs are not required by its stated constraints. Confirm all related data and backups remain in approved EU locations.
The customer manages the EC2 guest operating system and S3 data access policy. AWS manages the underlying cloud infrastructure.
A Lambda execution role supplies temporary credentials to the function. Scope its policy to the source read and destination write instead of storing a long-term access key.

A permissions boundary can cap permissions only while every relevant identity has the boundary and teams cannot remove or bypass it. An organization SCP can set an account-level maximum where the organization structure permits it.
An S3 lifecycle rule can transition older objects to an archive class and expire them at the retention boundary. The choice aligns access frequency with storage class.
A presigned URL provides temporary access under the signer’s permissions. A 24-hour link works only if the signing credentials remain valid for that period.
EFS provides shared file-system access for multiple EC2 instances across Availability Zones. EBS is block storage, and S3 is object storage.
Spot fits interruption-tolerant work and can reduce compute cost. The exact savings vary, and the job must handle interruption and retry safely.

A NAT gateway with a private-subnet default route permits outbound connections while preventing unsolicited inbound connections. Security-group egress and network ACL rules must also permit the payment API path.
A network ACL supports subnet-level rules with explicit deny and ordered evaluation. Security groups allow traffic and attach to network interfaces.

DynamoDB Global Tables with on-demand capacity is the best listed fit for a serverless multi-Region key-value workload. The stem still requires workload tests and quota checks to validate latency and request rate.

The stem does not give enough detail to establish that one Lambda invocation can process the file within the time target. Validate the actual file shape, processing duration, retry behavior, and service limits before selecting Lambda.
CloudTrail event history can identify the principal and API action that changed a security group. CloudWatch logs and Config answer different operational questions.
SNS fan-out can deliver an event to separate subscriptions, where SQS can buffer consumers independently. A single work queue distributes each message to a consumer instead of broadcasting it.
A REST API supports usage plans, API keys, and caching. Usage-plan throttles and quotas are best-effort controls, and API keys identify usage rather than authenticate customers.

SSE-KMS with a customer-managed key supports CloudTrail key-use audit events and key disablement. It cannot revoke plaintext already obtained, and audit coverage depends on the request path and configuration.

CloudFormation templates and drift detection improve repeatability and reveal out-of-band changes. They do not prevent console edits by themselves. Access controls and a deployment policy are also needed.
AWS Organizations supports consolidated billing across member accounts. Cost allocation tags can attribute supported usage to teams when tags are activated and applied.
A DynamoDB gateway VPC endpoint gives a private-subnet route to DynamoDB without a NAT gateway. The timeout points to missing network connectivity, not broad IAM permissions.
Security groups are stateful controls on network interfaces. Network ACLs are stateless subnet controls with ordered allow and deny rules.

Use an S3 lifecycle transition after the high-read period and configure Object Lock compliance retention for at least the required period. Object Lock requires versioning, and the retention setting must cover the 90-day deletion restriction.
IAM Identity Center provides workforce single sign-on to AWS accounts through permission sets and federated identity. Cognito serves application users.

A dead-letter queue with a redrive policy isolates repeatedly failing messages for diagnosis. Queue behavior differs by standard versus FIFO queue, so validate the chosen queue’s delivery and ordering requirements.
Kinesis Data Streams carries click events, Firehose can deliver stream data to S3, and DataBrew supports visual data preparation. This matches the stream, storage, and no-code analyst requirements.

A high-cardinality category can become impractical as many one-hot columns. Embeddings or feature hashing can represent categories with bounded dimensionality, subject to model and quality validation.

XGBoost is a suitable built-in algorithm for labeled tabular churn classification among these options. It is not a universal default; algorithm selection depends on task requirements and data characteristics.
Recall of 0.30 means the model identifies only a minority of actual fraud cases at this threshold. Accuracy can mislead when the positive class is rare.

A real-time endpoint fits steady, interactive traffic with a strict latency goal among these options. Confirm the selected instance and model meet the application’s latency target under representative load.
A change in input distributions is data drift. Investigate the feature pipeline and collect labels before judging outcome quality or retraining from current evidence alone.
Real-time inference fits steady live requests. Recall addresses the stated cost of missed tumors, but its threshold and trade-off with false positives require clinical validation.
